external_benchmark_context.task: Entrants wrote faster versions of five pieces of the GPU code that serves Meta's Muse Spark Open model. Each submission was checked against a reference on fresh inputs and timed on an NVIDIA H200 against the open-source SGLang server's own kernel in the same run.

field_definitions.rank: position of team dogfoodarchitect on the organizer's per-problem board, with the SGLang reference row left out
field_definitions.total_teams: teams on the board, with the SGLang reference row left out
field_definitions.percentile: rank divided by total_teams, as a percentage with one decimal: the share of teams at or above this entry
field_definitions.speedup_vs_sglang: how many times as fast as SGLang's own kernel the entry ran, in the same timed run
field_definitions.median_team_speedup: median speedup of all teams on the board, SGLang row left out
field_definitions.first_place_speedup: speedup of the first row on the board

caveats: On 2026-11-05 the organizers wrote that the scores on the leaderboard were not final; on 2026-11-11 they wrote that their review of the kernel track was finished and that the Kernels (Overall) tab shows the final top 100 list. The author's entry is not in that top 100 list.
The updates page does not say whether the per-problem boards are final.
Every team on every board beats the SGLang reference, so rank and the median team are the comparisons that matter.
The kernel track carried no prize money; the contest pays its prizes on a separate serving track.
The contest was built for AI coding agents as well as people. Other entrants could use AI too.
The board entry dogfoodarchitect is the author's GitHub account.

verified_programs_notes: No public page shows these acceptances; they rest on the author's word.

test_descriptions.cellular_field_binary_vs_json: Two workers evolve an identical cellular field. One round-trips the state through JSON at every step; the other updates resident typed arrays. Checksums verify both paths produced the same logical state. Field size from 64 x 64 to 1024 x 1024 cells.
test_descriptions.131078_point_3d_gaussian_scene: A 3D Gaussian scene with linked cameras and equal deformation work in two views. Choose 32,768, 65,536 or the full 131,078 Gaussians. Worker processing is reported separately from presented updates.

import_repair.behavior_detail: An AI model may only propose how a supplier's catalog columns map to product fields. A separate check, with no model in it, converts every price to whole cents or refuses the whole batch.
demo_expected: Preset base-repair, Execute Ingestion Contract: ACCEPTED — 2 ROWS VERIFIED, with $12.50 stored as 1250 cents.
Preset subcent-refusal (price 1.005 dollars): REFUSED — ZERO PARTIAL ROWS ACCEPTED, refusal code INVALID_PRICE_PRECISION, no partial rows kept.
Suggest Mapping (Nemotron) needs a server and an API key that the public page does not have, so there it shows MAPPING REQUEST FAILED.
